cards.name: Battery low, running on grid fallback

cards.content: Grid fallback closes at **30%** and opens again at **40%** (automations). Change inverter limits below only if you know why.
**Status only.** Floor breakers feed the router, Wi-Fi and this server: switching one off from here can take the whole network down with no remote way back. Use the physical breaker.

confirmation.text: Switch grid fallback by hand? The battery automations may switch it back.
Switch the CHEST FREEZER plug? Food may spoil if left off.
